<template>
    <v-card>
      <v-card-title>Value and return over time</v-card-title>
      <v-card-text>
        <v-row>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="4">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedBreakdown"
              :items="breakdownOptions"
              label="Breakdown by"
              @change="updateChart"
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="4">
            <v-btn-toggle v-model="selectedFrequency" mandatory @change="updateChart">
              <v-btn value="D">D</v-btn>
              <v-btn value="W">W</v-btn>
              <v-btn value="M">M</v-btn>
              <v-btn value="Q">Q</v-btn>
              <v-btn value="Y">Y</v-btn>
            </v-btn-toggle>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="4">
            <v-menu
              ref="menu"
              v-model="menu"
              :close-on-content-click="false"
              transition="scale-transition"
              offset-y
              max-width="290px"
              min-width="290px"
            >
              <template v-slot:activator="{ on, attrs }">
                <v-text-field
                  v-model="dateRangeText"
                  label="Date Range"
                  prepend-icon="mdi-calendar"
                  readonly
                  v-bind="attrs"
                  v-on="on"
                ></v-text-field>
              </template>
              <v-date-picker
                v-model="dateRange"
                range
                no-title
                @input="menu = false"
              ></v-date-picker>
            </v-menu>
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
        <v-chart :option="chartOption" autoresize />
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  import { ref, computed, onMounted, watch } from 'vue'
  import { use } from 'echarts/core'
  import { CanvasRenderer } from 'echarts/renderers'
  import { BarChart, LineChart } from 'echarts/charts'
  import {
    TitleComponent,
    TooltipComponent,
    LegendComponent,
    GridComponent,
    DataZoomComponent,
  } from 'echarts/components'
  import VChart from 'vue-echarts'
  import { getChartData } from '@/services/api'
  
  use([
    CanvasRenderer,
    BarChart,
    LineChart,
    TitleComponent,
    TooltipComponent,
    LegendComponent,
    GridComponent,
    DataZoomComponent,
  ])
  
  export default {
    name: 'NAVChart',
    components: {
      VChart,
    },
    setup() {
      const selectedBreakdown = ref('Broker')
      const selectedFrequency = ref('M')
      const dateRange = ref([])
      const menu = ref(false)
      const chartData = ref(null)
  
      const breakdownOptions = [
        { text: 'Broker', value: 'Broker' },
        { text: 'Asset type', value: 'Asset type' },
        { text: 'Asset class', value: 'Asset class' },
        { text: 'Currency', value: 'Currency' },
        { text: 'No breakdown', value: 'No breakdown' },
        { text: 'Value contributions', value: 'Contributions' },
      ]
  
      const dateRangeText = computed(() => {
        return dateRange.value.join(' - ')
      })
  
      const chartOption = computed(() => {
        if (!chartData.value) return {}
  
        return {
          tooltip: {
            trigger: 'axis',
            axisPointer: {
              type: 'cross',
              crossStyle: {
                color: '#999'
              }
            }
          },
          legend: {
            data: chartData.value.legend
          },
          xAxis: [
            {
              type: 'category',
              data: chartData.value.labels,
              axisPointer: {
                type: 'shadow'
              }
            }
          ],
          yAxis: [
            {
              type: 'value',
              name: chartData.value.currency,
              axisLabel: {
                formatter: '{value}'
              }
            },
            {
              type: 'value',
              name: 'IRR',
              axisLabel: {
                formatter: '{value}%'
              }
            }
          ],
          series: chartData.value.datasets.map(dataset => ({
            name: dataset.label,
            type: dataset.type,
            yAxisIndex: dataset.yAxisIndex,
            data: dataset.data,
            stack: dataset.stack
          }))
        }
      })
  
      const updateChart = async () => {
        try {
          const data = await getChartData({
            frequency: selectedFrequency.value,
            from: dateRange.value[0],
            to: dateRange.value[1],
            breakdown: selectedBreakdown.value
          })
          chartData.value = data
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching chart data:', error)
        }
      }
  
      onMounted(updateChart)
  
      watch([selectedBreakdown, selectedFrequency, dateRange], updateChart)
  
      return {
        selectedBreakdown,
        selectedFrequency,
        dateRange,
        menu,
        breakdownOptions,
        dateRangeText,
        chartOption,
        updateChart
      }
    }
  }
  </script>
